title: Feedback

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: We try to take as much Feedback as possible. We appreciate feedback and how we should improve the staff team. I have been trying to gather as much feedback as possible to bring up to all staff or seniors (or mapdevs as what you said on your thread :P) to bring up issues or suggestions from player feedback. I appreciate feedback very much and please continue making feedback threads (but not too much that it floods the forums). If you have any questions regarding this topic or anything else, please find me on ts/skype/Ingame or create a new discussion.
